Subject: IndigoAI — committed pool path and ops capture

Hi Ethan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the key asks we captured so we can align internally and with your infra team. TL;DR: IndigoAI is aiming for a Q2 launch for inference on sensitive patient triage models; preferred approach is a reserved, isolated GPU pool with burst capacity and a 99.9% P95 latency SLO for the 256-token tail.

What we heard (pain points):
- Production variability: current self-hosted endpoints at Indigo experience noisy neighbor interference and occasional preemption during batch jobs.
- Cost drift: inference cost spikes when models run longer sequences; need predictable unit economics.
- Compliance: logs and KMS-backed key management required for audit readiness.

Goals you stated:
- Dedicated, isolated pool for patient-triage model serving (pilot: 8x A10G-equivalent GPUs).
- SLOs: 99.9% availability monthly, P95 latency target <= 180ms for standard requests, mitigation/fallback for heavier requests.
- Ops handoff: a runbook + canary rollout with automatic fallback to a smaller, cheaper variant during incidents.

Agreed next steps (for clarity):
1) Redwood to share a draft SOW + topology diagram by EOD Thursday (attached).
2) Indigo infra to provide the IP allowlist and KMS provider details (Leila).
3) Procurement: Indigo will provision a purchase order once SOW aligns; target sign date: within 2 weeks.
4) Tech deep-dive: 60–90 minute session with ops/infra and our runtime team — proposed: Mon 2/23.

Attachments: indigo-sow-draft.pdf (SOW skeleton), isolation-topology-diagram.png

Open questions we flagged for our internal follow-up:
- Burst policy thresholds and expected concurrency profile during peak windows (you mentioned nightly batch spikes).
- Data residency requirements for logs (region-specific retention).

If this matches your understanding, reply with any edits and confirm Leila is the right contact for the infra items. I’ll loop in engineering and Marissa for procurement coordination.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: IndigoAI — committed pool path and ops capture

Thanks, Sofia — that looks accurate and helpful. A few clarifications from our side: we do want the pool to be isolated from shared tenants (VPC-level isolation) and we’ll need HSM-backed KMS for keys — we use CloudTrust KMS.

On sizing, the 8x A10G pilot is our expectation, but we may expand to 16 if the canary results look good. For burst policy: our peak nightly throughput is roughly 600 concurrent short requests and 40 long-running batched jobs; those batched jobs are the noisy neighbor risk.

Procurement: I’m the deal owner but Leila will handle PO/contract. We’ll aim to get PO within 10 business days once we have the SOW.

Confirming Monday 2/23 for the tech deep-dive at 10:00 PT works for us.

— Ethan
